blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The decision of the prosecution to drop three of the four impeachment charges against Vice President Sara Duterte has drawn criticism on Tuesday. Analysts described the move as an all-or-nothing gamble, while an advocacy group lamented that allegations of confidential fund misuse would remain unresolved. The prosecution had concentrated the trial’s outcome on a single accusation, said Ederson Tapia, a public administration professor at the University of Makati. “The prosecution has effectively placed all its eggs in one basket,” Tapia said in a text message.
